name: boltz
description: Fold proteins/complexes/protein-ligand and estimate binding affinity with Boltz-2 on Aurora XPU; one row per prediction, returns pdb/cif + confidence (+ affinity) JSON.

example.input:
version: 1
sequences:
  - protein:
      id: A
      sequence: MQIFVKTLTGKTITLEVEPSDTIENVKAKIQDKEGIPPDQQRLIFAGKQLEDGRTLSDYNIQKESTLHLVLRLRGG
      msa: empty

_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §5). A thin 'skills' MCP tool boltz.fold(inputs, defaults) validates each row against row_schema, write_files-stages inputs.jsonl + the runner, and calls loam-hpc run_batch(script_path=runner, inputs_path=jsonl, gpus=1, timeout_each). Install paths come from site.<system>.json, resolved worker-side.
